_doc: IDWriteTextAnalyzer (most-derived IDWriteTextAnalyzer2). The hand subclass IDWriteTextAnalyzer.ts adds the low-level shaping + justification pipeline. getGlyphs/getGlyphPlacements/getGdiCompatibleGlyphPlacements are auto-dropped by the emitter (const DWRITE_TYPOGRAPHIC_FEATURES ** param it can't lower); the justification methods are skipped here because they pass several parallel glyphCount-sized in/out arrays the emitter mis-lowers as single-element structs (under-allocating the out buffers). The *_PROPERTIES buffers are passed through as raw packed UINT16 arrays (the native bit-field layout).

IDWriteTextAnalyzer.GetGlyphs._why: hand getGlyphs(textString, scriptAnalysis, fontFace, opts): allocates parallel out arrays (clusterMap/textProps/glyphIndices/glyphProps) and grows on E_NOT_SUFFICIENT_BUFFER; const DWRITE_TYPOGRAPHIC_FEATURES ** is unsupported by the emitter

IDWriteTextAnalyzer.GetGlyphPlacements._why: hand getGlyphPlacements(args): parallel in/out arrays sharing glyphCount; same unsupported feature-array param

IDWriteTextAnalyzer.GetGdiCompatibleGlyp._why: hand getGdiCompatibleGlyphPlacements(args): same as getGlyphPlacements plus pixelsPerDip/transform/useGdiNatural

IDWriteTextAnalyzer.ApplyCharacterSpacin._why: hand applyCharacterSpacing(args): parallel glyphCount-sized in/out arrays; emitter mis-lowers the out arrays as single elements and overflows the buffer

IDWriteTextAnalyzer.GetJustificationOppo._why: hand getJustificationOpportunities(args): glyphCount-sized DWRITE_JUSTIFICATION_OPPORTUNITY out array mis-lowered as a single struct

IDWriteTextAnalyzer.JustifyGlyphAdvances._why: hand justifyGlyphAdvances(args): parallel glyphCount-sized in/out arrays mis-lowered as single elements

IDWriteTextAnalyzer.GetJustifiedGlyphs._why: hand getJustifiedGlyphs(args): parallel in/out arrays + maxGlyphCount/actualGlyphCount growth; emitter mis-lowers and overflows
